name: Jean-Baptiste Cupis — burial in May 1788, Montreuil, France
researcher_question: When and where was Jean-Baptiste Cupis buried? He was the son of Ferdinand-Joseph Cupis and Marie-Anne De Smedt, was christened in Brussels on 23 November 1711, married Constance Dufour in 1729, and died on 30 April 1788.
